title: Implement iOSStrategy for Safari on iPhone/iPad
acceptance_criteria: Internal _isPlayPending flag and _state: PlaybackState ref tracked
gesturePlay sets audio.src, calls audio.play() (within gesture stack = works on iOS)
gesturePlay fallback on rejection: mutes audio, plays, then unmutes in .then()
gesturePlay sets _isPlayPending=true before play, false in .then()/.catch()
nonGesturePlay sets _isPlayPending=true, audio.src=url, mutes, calls audio.play()
destroy() clears no timers (no-op for iOS)
